idea.title: Five-minute study break
idea.summary: Swap a reel scroll that eats forty minutes for a five-minute call with another stressed student, then both go back to studying.
hookOptions: Stuck on your phone instead of studying?
Exam tomorrow? Take a better break
I opened reels for 5 minutes. It was an hour.
Your brain needs a break, not a scroll

scenes.say: Stuck on your phone instead of studying?
Reels: forty minutes gone. A stranger: five minutes.

scenes.name: Sleepy Mango
scenes.say: Someone else is hiding from their textbook too.

scenes.name: Sleepy Mango

messages.text: biology at 9 and my brain is soup
chemistry at 10. soup with extra salt
tell me one thing you actually know
salt is sodium chloride. i'm an expert now

scenes.say: He explains salt. I explain nothing. Perfect.
Timer beeped. Sleepy Mango said "sodium chloride, bye." I opened biology.

post.caption:
Five minutes with a stranger beats forty minutes of scrolling. Set a timer, talk, then go back to the books. What's your exam this week?
Take your break on randomtalker.com
